summary: The agent performs extensive biophysical feature engineering and constructs a well-validated hybrid ensemble using LightGBM and a deep learning model. However, it commits a critical task formulation error by averaging the target array into a single scalar value per sequence, destroying the position-specific signal the task requires. Consequently, the resulting models predict only one value per sequence, leading to an invalid submission format.
